concepts.gloss_en: The action of (the voice/thunder) striking the thick rain-clouds — an action about the clouds, not the clouds themselves

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are in the same paragraph (LM 1:5) and both cite the same Zohar phrase describing the voice striking the rain-clouds to produce thunder. The only difference is the prefix כש- ('when'), which is a prepositional/inflectional variation of the identical action, not a distinct concept. Clear same-word merge.
